turn: The "Daily ECB exchange rates" step is finished. The last commit, "test(ecb): convert SEK with a fixed rate set", adds tests in test/ecb.test.js for the conversion helper. One test checks that 1000 SEK converts to 87.1 EUR with a fixed rate of 0.0871. The other checks that an unknown currency such as XYZ throws. I didn't run the tests in this final step, so I can't say they pass. The tests use a fixed rate set, so they don't depend on the live ECB feed. In the same commit I made one small fix I noticed along the way. I corrected the import path in the test file so it points at src/ecb/convert.js. Next I'll start "Dedupe across marketplaces".

sidefix.title: Correct test import path for converter
sidefix.what: Corrected the import in test/ecb.test.js so it resolves to src/ecb/convert.js.
